lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 001: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: US-R1-001 done: added readableEnded short-circuit at top of ask() so collectViaReadline({}, eofStream) resolves immediately instead of hanging when the stream is already ended. All 1683 tests pass. No further stories remain in this PRD (all passes:true). Ready for /cam-review.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed: 'close' fires when the input stream RECEIVES its 'end' event. A pre-ended stream has already emitted 'end' before the readline interface is attached, so 'close' never fires on subsequent interfaces. The readableEnded short-circuit is the correct production fix.
